title: Quantum symmetries and nimreps for an exotic exceptional modular invariant of F4 at level 6
summary: We revisit an old non-diagonal modular invariant of $F_4$ at level $6$, discovered in 1989. At the time of its discovery, it was noticed that it could not be obtained from a conformal embedding of affine Lie algebras. Later, it was shown that it can be obtained from an extension of a vertex operator algebra which is not of Lie type. To this modular invariant, one can attach a full CFT defined (or formulated) as a module category $\mathcal M$ for the fusion category $\mathcal A = \mathcal C(F_4,6)$.
